faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions About NEXBODY Solutions

items.question: What products does NEXBODY offer?
items.answer: NEXBODY offers three professional assessment solutions: the X60 Body Assessment System, OneScan Gait Analysis System, and F20 Foot Scanner.

items.question: Which industries can benefit from NEXBODY solutions?
items.answer: NEXBODY solutions are designed for fitness centers, rehabilitation clinics, wellness facilities, sports performance centers, and footwear businesses.

items.question: What can the NEXBODY X60 measure?
items.answer: The NEXBODY X60 provides body composition analysis, posture assessment, and mobility evaluation to support professional fitness and wellness assessments.

items.question: How can I get a demo of NEXBODY products?
items.answer: Contact the NEXBODY team to schedule a product demonstration and explore how our assessment solutions can meet your business needs.
